data.title: Christmas Murder Mystery Game for up to 20, Holiday Family Murder Mystery Dinner, Printable Invitation, Certificates, Host Guide, Download
data.description:
The shop owner is currently out of the country. Sales are still open, but any questions will be answered after November 15.

Add an element of intrigue and suspense to your holiday gathering with our 'Murder at Snowflake Lodge' Christmas resort mystery game. Transport your guests to the enchanting Snowflake Lodge, where the festive spirit and secrets collide, and an unsolved murder shrouds the celebration. The 'Murder at Snowflake Lodge' provides hours of thrilling entertainment, making it the perfect centerpiece for a memorable and suspense-filled holiday party. Whether it's for family, friends, or coworkers, this game promises an unforgettable Yuletide gathering filled with mystery, suspense, and seasonal cheer.

****CHECK OUT MY SHOP FOR ALL MY MURDER MYSTERY GAMES*****


Our package comes complete with bonus mobile and printable invitation templates, so you can set the stage for an unforgettable night of holiday intrigue. You'll also receive award certificates to celebrate the best sleuths and actors among your guests. And for the host, we've got you covered with a comprehensive host guide, ensuring you have all the tools and information to create an unforgettable evening of entertainment. Whether you're a seasoned detective or a first-time party planner, our Christmas Murder Mystery game promises endless fun, memorable moments, and a night you and your guests won't soon forget. 

Play with 8-20 players.

WHAT'S INCLUDED 
54-Page Instant Download (8.5"x11" PDF and 5x7") Document that includes characters and host guide (Non-editable)
Bonus Inksaver Version
1080X1920 Pixel Editable Mobile Invitation (Edit party details with a Canva Account)
5x7" Printable Invitation (Edit party details with a Canva Account)
4- Certificates (Non-editable)

THERE ARE NO REFUNDS ON DIGITAL FILES. PLEASE REVIEW ALL INFORMATION AND PHOTOS BEFORE PURCHASING. NOT ALL MURDER MYSTERY GAMES ARE SIMILAR, AS YOU MAY HAVE PURCHASED A GAME FROM ANOTHER WRITER WHICH IS FORMATTED DIFFERENTLY.


DETAILS:
Theme: Christmas
Players: Up to 20 Players
Gender: Mix of Genders
Character Cards Include: Appearance, Background, Secret
Certificates for Most Believable, Most Deceitful, Best Detective and Best Dressed
Host Guide: Suggested Timeline, Instructions, Host Tips, Prop Tips, Rules, Party Intro, Clues, Refreshment Suggestions, Whodidit Card
Suitable for: Adults, Older Teens

Not included: Props (You will have prop suggestions though)
Due to the nature of the game and the flexibility of the number of players, this is not scripted dialogue. Clues are provided that spur conversation to get the players talking and investigating.

HOW TO PLAY (More details in game)
1. Read the rules, host intro and/or party scene, and victim profile which starts off with the murder as already occurring.
2. Each character shares their background.
3. Read the first clue(s) and let participants discuss/question one another.
4. Repeat for the remainder of the clues.
5. Let participants share their thoughts on who is the murderer.
6. Player reveal their secret and the murderer confesses. 

DOES THE HOST KNOW WHO THE MURDERER IS? YES! It is important for the host to have the complete information to best facilitate the game.
-----------------------------------
HOW TO DOWNLOAD THE PRINTABLE CHRISTMAS MURDER MYSTERY GAME
------------------------------------
• Once purchased, your file will be available instantly via a PDF file. (FROM A COMPUTER ONLY.)
• After payment, follow the link to your Etsy Download page. Or log into Etsy and go to Your Purchases and Reviews tab.

COLOR DISCLAIMER
Color calibration varies from device including mobile devices. Your colors may print differently from what you see on your screen, therefore it is difficult to guaranteed 100% color accuracy as printers may convert your file to CMYK from RGB. Everyone sees colors differently.

This item is available for personal use only and may not be distributed for commercial use. This item may not be resold. This game cannot be used for or with any business, organized group, for-profit, or organization.

Murder mystery games do take time to prepare and aren't intended as last minute games. 

Per Etsy, digital downloads are not refundable, including for lack of preparation from the purchaser.
